design.question: Do actual P06 parry, directional dodge and one seal produce distinct defensive/offensive opportunities under an identical phase-one sweep trace?
design.hypothesis: Close/live parry prevents sweep damage and opens an early blade counter; dodge trades position and commitment for avoidance; a single seal applies pressure without interrupting this sweep.
design.rival_or_failure: Responses might yield equivalent safe timings/positions/early counter outcomes, or controls may fail to detect damage/rejected inputs. Distinction in this matrix does not establish perceived class identity.
design.preregistration: Not pre-registered. Hypothesis and fixed inputs were chosen during design; first exploratory run informed added contact/resource/stage reporting. Input cases were unchanged.
design.unit: One controlled native take. Two repetitions are consistency checks, not people or independent statistical samples.
design.inputs: 28 explicit cases, 60 Hz, 100 ticks, same early blade request at tick 53. No random seed because source sweep and inputs are deterministic.
design.controls: Neutral near/far; early/late; 110/111/150px; zero resolve at request; imposed echo using actual native path. Origin parry regression separately retained.
design.instrumentation: External GDScript loads unchanged arena.tscn, calls actual step_fight once per native physics frame; original PhysicsServer, contact, resources, projectile and damage rules execute. No copied Python combat model.

environment.audio: Origin audio nodes/resources load; no physical listening or timing study claimed.
environment.processes: Runner imports/probes with owned temporary XDG paths and 120-second subprocess deadlines; normal completion waits/reaps processes. Interrupted unimported probe was stopped.
environment.dependencies: Python standard library and existing Godot; no new runtime package/service/engine migration.

observations.guard: At 85px, leads 5/8 ticks: six health, one parry, 24 early blade damage; leads 2/12/18: five health, no parry, 4 guarded damage.
observations.movement: All five outward dodges avoid damage but finish 219.333313px from boss and early three blade requests are rejected during movement. Inward leads 2/5/8 avoid damage; leads 12/18 lose one health after protection expires.
observations.pressure: All single-seal cases lose one health; latest request is interrupted before release. Other releases cause eight damage and 36 ward pressure without cancelling sweep; common blade adds four guarded damage.
observations.range: 110px parry succeeds but blade at >103px misses. Same guard at111/150px loses one health.
observations.failure_controls: Zero-resolve guard/dodge rejected. Overlap parries the sweep but real echo still damages. Neutral near hit; neutral outside165px safe.
observations.all_outcomes: results.json retains every repetition and event; no selective exclusion of failed cases.

assessment.technical: Executed same-engine origin mechanisms show distinct bounded response envelopes and early opportunity, with repeatability and negative controls.
assessment.creative: Codex reasoning: timing alone does not capture identity; position, range and commitment meaningfully change the same early counter choice. Guard-at110px demonstrates why safe defense and reachable offense differ. This is a candidate design insight, not a player finding.
assessment.destination: Laboratory actually consumes P06. No North Star destination code or class consumer exists; no catalog promotion to adapted/integrated for North Star.
assessment.external_validation: None. No independent player/artist/scientist review, physical control/listening, demand, retention or commercial evidence.
